concept: RDS Multi-AZ: automatic failover with no data loss
tests: Choosing an HA solution for a relational DB in one Region that survives an AZ failure.
expected: RDS Multi-AZ — synchronous standby, automatic failover via DNS with no data loss. Triggers: "single AZ failure", "automatic failover", "no data loss", "single Region".
why_not: A cross-Region read replica is asynchronous and promoted manually; dual writes are complex and unreliable; Single-AZ with backups means manual recovery and data loss.
